pages.body:
This is a plain text page.
No formatting at all — just the words you typed in the spreadsheet.
The gimmick displays it as-is.
pages.translation: Each PAGE BREAK row in the sheet becomes one page in the VRChat book.
pages.kana: ぷれーんてきすとのぺーじです。
pages.dictionary: Plain text — text with no colour, bold, italic, or any other formatting applied.

pages.body:
You can have as many Page Breaks per chapter as you like.
The gimmick advances through them one at a time.
This is the second page of Chapter 1.
pages.translation: Multiple page breaks let you split a long chapter into smaller readable sections.
pages.kana: ぺーじぶれーくはいくつでもついかできます。
pages.dictionary: Page Break — a row that defines where one page ends and the next begins in the VRChat book.

pages.body: Text colour is applied per character run in the spreadsheet. Select any word, change its font colour, and the parser wraps it in a tag automatically. You never type the tags — the upload script does it for you.
pages.translation: Try selecting a word in the Body cell and changing its <color=#e06c75>font colour</color> via Format → Text formatting.
pages.kana: からーは<color=#e06c75>もじごとに</color>せっていできます。
pages.dictionary: <color=#rrggbb> — TMP tag that changes text colour. Applied automatically by the upload script.

pages.body:
Examples:
<color=#e06c75>This word is red.  </color><color=#61afef>This word is blue.  </color><color=#98c379>This word is green.
</color><color=#e5c07b>This word is yellow.  </color><color=#c678dd>This word is purple.  </color><color=#56b6c2>This word is cyan.</color>
pages.translation: Each of these words has a different font colour set directly in the spreadsheet cell.
pages.kana: <color=#e06c75>あか  </color><color=#61afef>あお  </color><color=#98c379>みどり  </color><color=#e5c07b>きいろ  </color><color=#c678dd>むらさき  </color><color=#56b6c2>みずいろ</color>
pages.dictionary: Colour tags are read from the cell's RichTextValue — each run of differently-coloured text becomes its own <color> tag in the JSON.

pages.body: Four text styles are supported: Bold — for emphasis or important words. Italic — for titles, foreign words, or inner thoughts. Underline — for key terms. Strikethrough — for corrections or crossed-out text.
pages.translation: Apply these via Format → Text formatting in Google Sheets. The upload script converts them to TMP tags.
pages.kana: ぼーるど いたりっく あんだーらいん すとらいくする
pages.dictionary: <b> bold  |  <i> italic  |  <u> underline  |  <s> strikethrough — the four TMP text style tags.

pages.body: Styles can be combined. For example: bold red, italic blue, or underline green. Tags nest in order: →→→→
pages.translation: Styles and colours can be combined freely. The upload script nests the tags in a consistent order.
pages.kana: くみあわせも できます。
pages.dictionary: Tag nesting — combining multiple TMP tags on the same text run. Order: color → bold → italic → underline → strikethrough.

pages.body:
When Translation Mode is enabled, each page carries a second field with a translation of the body text.
The Translation field is shown in the Translation column of each PAGE BREAK row.
pages.translation: This is the translation field. It appears alongside the body in the VRChat book.
pages.kana: ほんやくもーどがゆうこうのとき、すべてのぺーじにほんやくふぃーるどがひょうじされます。
pages.dictionary: Translation Mode — when enabled, a translation field is added to every page of the book.

pages.body:
翻訳モードのデモです。
この文章は日本語で書かれています。
pages.translation:
This is a Translation Mode demo.
This sentence is written in Japanese.
pages.kana:
ほんやくもーどのでもです。
このぶんしょうはにほんごでかかれています。
pages.dictionary: 翻訳 (ほんやく) — translation. The act of converting text from one language to another.

pages.body:
When Kana Mode is enabled, each page carries a kana reading field.
This shows the pronunciation of the body text in hiragana or katakana.
pages.translation: Kana Mode is especially useful for Japanese text with difficult kanji readings.
pages.kana: かなもーどがゆうこうのとき、すべてのぺーじにかなよみがひょうじされます。
pages.dictionary: かな (仮名) — the phonetic Japanese scripts. Hiragana (ひらがな) and katakana (カタカナ).

pages.body:
漢字の読み方が分からないとき、かなモードが役に立ちます。
例：桃太郎は鬼ヶ島へ旅に出ました。
pages.translation:
When you do not know how to read kanji, Kana Mode is useful.
Example: Momotaro set out on a journey to Oni Island.
pages.kana:
かんじのよみかたがわからないとき、かなもーどがやくにたちます。
れい：ももたろうはおにがしまへたびにでました。
pages.dictionary: 漢字 (かんじ) — Chinese characters used in Japanese writing. Can be difficult to read without furigana.

pages.body:
Dictionary Mode adds a glossary field to each page.
Use it to explain difficult words, cultural context, or grammar notes.
pages.translation: The dictionary field can contain any text — definitions, notes, or extra context for the reader.
pages.kana: じしょもーどは、かくぺーじにたんごのせつめいをついかします。
pages.dictionary: Dictionary Mode — adds a per-page field for vocabulary notes, definitions, and cultural context.

pages.body: きびだんごを食べると、仲間になってくれます。
pages.translation: If you eat a millet dumpling, they will become your companion.
pages.kana: きびだんごをたべると、なかまになってくれます。
pages.dictionary: きびだんご — millet dumpling, a traditional Japanese sweet. In the story of Momotaro, sharing one creates loyalty and companionship.

pages.body: With all modes enabled, each page shows: Body • Translation • Kana • Dictionary
pages.translation: Translation, Kana, and Dictionary are all shown simultaneously alongside the body text.
pages.kana: すべてのもーどをおんにすると、<color=#e06c75>ほんぶん</color>・<color=#61afef>ほんやく</color>・<color=#98c379>かな</color>・<color=#c678dd>じしょ</color>がすべてひょうじされます。
pages.dictionary: Body — the main text of the page. Translation — the translated version. Kana — the phonetic reading. Dictionary — vocabulary notes and definitions.

pages.body: これがデモブックの最後のページです。 ご覧いただき、ありがとうございました！
pages.translation:
This is the last page of the demo book.
Thank you for reading!
pages.kana: これがでもぶっくのさいごのぺーじです。ごらんいただき、ありがとうございました！
pages.dictionary: 最後 (さいご) — the last, the end.  ありがとうございました — thank you (polite past form).
